auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Elastic Email API key used with the X-ElasticEmail-ApiKey request header. Manage access tokens in the Elastic Email API settings: https://app.elasticemail.com/marketing/settings/new/manage-api.

actions.name: add_contacts
actions.description: Add up to 1000 contacts to Elastic Email and optionally assign them to lists.

email.description: Proper email address accepted by Elastic Email.

customFields.description: Key-value collection of Elastic Email custom contact fields.

consentIp.description: IP address of consent to send email; Elastic Email uses the current public IP when omitted.

consentDate.description: Date of consent to send email.

consent.description: Consent data accepted by Elastic Email contact write endpoints.

items.description: One contact payload accepted by the Elastic Email add-contacts endpoint.

contacts.description: Contact payloads to create or add through Elastic Email.

listNames.description: Names of lists to which Elastic Email should add the uploaded contacts.

inputSchema.description: Request payload for adding up to 1000 Elastic Email contacts.

CustomFields.description: Elastic Email custom contact fields returned for this contact.

anyOf.description: Date of consent returned by Elastic Email, when present.

ConsentDate.description: Date of consent returned by Elastic Email, when present.

ConsentTracking.description: Consent tracking value returned by Elastic Email.

Consent.description: Consent data returned by Elastic Email.

Source.description: Contact source returned by Elastic Email.

DateAdded.description: Date and time string returned by Elastic Email, usually in YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format.

anyOf.description: Last contact update date returned by Elastic Email, when present.

DateUpdated.description: Last contact update date returned by Elastic Email, when present.

anyOf.description: Last contact status-change date returned by Elastic Email.

StatusChangeDate.description: Last contact status-change date returned by Elastic Email.

Activity.description: Contact activity object returned by Elastic Email, when present.

items.description: Contact object returned by Elastic Email.

outputSchema.description: Contacts returned by the official Elastic Email API.
